name: It's Never Enough

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 28 Survival check (trained) to draw upon memories of leaner times and counteract the temptation of the promised meal or DC 31 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt; 2 successes are required to disable it, and once the haunt is disabled, the food on the table is revealed to be foul, rotting, and moldy.
reset: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which there are no living creatures in area D2, then reactivates 1 minute later.
routine:
(1 action; mental) On its initiative, the haunt exudes mental compulsions to all living creatures in the room, driving them to take part in the offered feast. Each living creature in the room must attempt a DC 26 Will save save with the following results. Food consumed during this hazard's routine is automatically replenished at the start of the next round.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is compelled to approach the table of food and be seated. On the creature's turn, it Strides as often as needed to reach the table, then Interacts with a chair to be seated. If it has any remaining actions, it can use them normally (such as by Interacting again to stand up from being seated at the table).
Failure As success, but the creature must spend at least one of its actions this turn (if any are available after potentially approaching and taking a seat) Interacting with the food to eat some of it. Eating the food afflicts the creature with Rancid Breakfast.
Critical Failure As failure, but the creature must use any actions not used to approach the table or be seated at it to Interact and eat food.

items.name: Break Your Fast
items.text:
Trigger A living creature enters area D2

---
Effect The sight and scent of the baked goods grows nearly irresistible. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 26 Will save save to avoid becoming Stupefied 1 (Stupefied 2 on a critical failure) for 24 hours. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: Rancid Breakfast
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude save (this increases to DC 28 Fortitude save if a creature spent two actions eating or DC 30 Fortitude save if a creature spent three actions eating)

Stage 1 Clumsy 1 (1 round) and 1d6 poison

Stage 2 clumsy 1 (1 hour) and 2d6 poison

Stage 3 Clumsy 2 (24 hours) and 4d6 poison

Stage 4 clumsy 2 (unlimited duration) and 6d6 poison

text: The smells and sights of fresh baked goods compel those who experience them to take part in a grisly feast.
